flux_manifests:
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: platform-config
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1m
  url: ssh://git@repo.internal/platform/config.git
  ref:
    branch: main
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: infra
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 5m
  path: ./clusters/prod/infra
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: platform-config
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: apps
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 5m
  path: ./clusters/prod/apps
  prune: true
  dependsOn:
    - name: infra
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: platform-config
---
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: metrics-server
  namespace: platform-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: ./charts/metrics-server
      sourceRef:
        kind: GitRepository
        name: platform-config
        namespace: flux-system
reasoning_answer: 有效的拓扑顺序可以是platform-config、infra、apps、metrics-server，其中metrics-server与infra实际上都只要求platform-config的源工件可用，放在apps之后只是该拓扑排序中的一种排列。apps的dependsOn明确要求infra先完成，因此apps不能与infra无条件并行。platform-config的提交会使infra、apps和metrics-server重新协调；其中infra到apps构成主依赖链，而metrics-server从GitRepository直接分支。
reasoning_question: 请给出这些对象的一种有效协调顺序，并分析platform-config中的配置变更会传播到哪些对象。apps是否必须等待infra完成？

config_change_propagation.change_explanation: GitRepository产生新的源工件后，引用该工件的infra和apps会重新协调。apps显式通过dependsOn依赖infra，因此只有infra协调成功后，apps才会继续应用配置。metrics-server也直接引用同一GitRepository，会沿独立分支重新协调；它不依赖apps或infra。
